description: Cortex gives ChatGPT a durable memory that survives across conversations. Save decisions and notes, search them by meaning, and get a synthesized recall of what's known on a topic — always with traceable sources. When new information contradicts what you saved, Cortex flags the conflict instead of silently overwriting it. Your data stays bound to your own subscription account. A SKYNETLAB product, patent-protected and in production.

defaultPrompt: Remember this decision for later and recall it withits source when I ask.
